shared_elements: circular disc form (round bosses in A, spoked wheel in B)
human or anthropomorphic figure with raised arms
figures arranged along a horizontal ground line
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on stone populated by profile quadrupeds, small anthropomorphic figures and at least one prominent circular element, and both organise figures along horizontal lines. But A stacks isolated, flat, schematic creatures in stacked registers on a tall pillar with a decorative banded frieze, whereas B is a single wide horizontal panel with modelled, overlapping, anatomically detailed animals and men locked into one continuous narrative action, so the compositional logic and level of naturalism are quite different.
